{{Quote|They're new in town. Been asking questions. Checking the bounty notice. I thought I heard them say something about a missing droid, but I could be wrong. They were getting pretty cozy with the Rodian girl as well, if you know what I mean.|Zalg, to Daro Blunt|<ref name="Trouble">{{FFG|story=Trouble Brewing|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>}}
'''Zalg''' was a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Zalg was present in the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on Formos, where he spotted a group of off-world individuals who were investigating the seizure the the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R4-W9]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]]. Zalg listened on their conversation and then made his way to the safehouse of a group of smugglers led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Daro Blunt]], who was connected to Dobah's smuggling ring, and he informed them of the off-worlders' activities. Blunt thanked Zalg for the information and paid the Toydarian 20 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the information.
